The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is therefore discharged on matching identifiers and timestamps.

The deviation is established on the governing trace figure. POL-RD-01 requires the threshold test to be run on gps_trace.trace_distance_km, not on the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km. The trace measures 14.4 km against an optimal of 9.0 km, an excess of 5.4 km and 60.0% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (5.4 km > 0.8 km; 60.0% > 20%), and the excess also exceeds the 50% / 8.0 km materiality gate, so this is a MATERIAL deviation.

The trace is clean for policy purposes: 114 fixes at a 10 s sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a max_gap_sec of 0.0, so no limb (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 is engaged and the deviation may be established on the trace alone without independent corroboration.

The driver's only explanation is 'Road works.' in the counterparty statement. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses, with a validity window overlapping the time the trace shows the vehicle would have reached it. The bundle holds no such advisory: EV-ADVIS-02851-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, so the comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The driver cites no advisory identifier, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-13(1) keeps POL-RD-10(5) from firing on it.

No rider-requested detour can excuse any part of the excess. The chat log for this trip carries zero messages, so there is no rider instruction, no chat_message.waypoint_hint and no named road; POL-RD-04(a) to (c) cannot be satisfied and the corroboration test cannot even be run. The excess is not reduced by any rider-caused distance.

No relocation clause applies. The trip_record shows original_pickup and original_dropoff both null, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null. There is no amended endpoint against which POL-RD-01 could be re-run, so the booked optimal of 9.0 km stands as the baseline.

The rider should not carry the disputed charge.
